exposure: MRI structure of abdominal wall endometriotic nodule
outcome: Relationship between nodule structure and localisation
cohort: Women who underwent MRI prior to surgical treatment of an abdominal wall endometriotic nodule between 2005 and 2016.
finding: No significant relationship was found between the structure of abdominal wall endometriotic nodules in MRI and their localisation in abdominal wall layers.
